Byzantine [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNIQUE_BUILDING_TOOLTIP]Unique Building[/TIP]. +8 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, and +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for every Tradition slotted in your empire. +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_QUARTER_TOOLTIP]Quarter[/TIP] and [icon:WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonder[/TIP]. [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGELESS_TOOLTIP]Ageless[/TIP]. Forms the Augustaion with the Great Palace. Can be purchased in Towns for about 600 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold.

Augustaion

Byzantine [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNIQUE_QUARTER_TOOLTIP]Unique Quarter[/TIP], formed by a Hippodrome and a Great Palace. +2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness in this Settlement for each [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Work[/TIP] displayed here. +4 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold and +2 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence, +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for every Tradition slotted in your empire, and +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture on every Walls of Theodosius in this Settlement.
+2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness in this Settlement for each [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] Great Work displayed here.
Hagia Sophia

+5 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, +3 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence, +2 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold and +1 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science. Each time a religion is spread to your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CAPITAL_TOOLTIP]Capital[/TIP], start a [icon:CELEBRATION] Celebration. Each time a unit is trained in your Capital, gain a Missionary there. Has 3 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Work[/TIP] slots. Gain a [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] when it is completed. [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGELESS_TOOLTIP]Ageless[/TIP].

Has 3 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Work[/TIP] slots. Gain a [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] when it is completed.
It seems not to rest upon solid masonry, but to cover the space with its golden dome suspended from Heaven.
Procopius
+45% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production from being Byzantium's associated [icon:WONDER] Wonder.
Byzantium: Great Palace
Cistern

Byzantine unique Antiquity Age building. +3 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food, +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness. +1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Coast or River tile. No maintenance. Ageless. Forms the Mese with the Milion.
Constantinople stored a year of water under its streets in vaulted cisterns fed by aqueducts from Thrace.
Milion

Byzantine unique Antiquity Age building. +5 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, +3 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence, +1 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness. +1 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence for each adjacent Quarter and +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent Wonder. Ageless. Forms the Mese with the Cistern.
The gilded milestone from which every road of the empire was measured.
Mese

Byzantine unique Antiquity Age quarter, formed by the Cistern and the Milion on the same tile. +1 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold, +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for each Settlement in your empire, doubled if the Mese is in a Town.
The colonnaded avenue of Constantinople, lined with forums and shops, with the great cisterns beneath.
Walls of Theodosius

Byzantine unique [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WALL_TOOLTIP]Wall[/TIP], available from the Themata civic instead of Castles. Turns the District into a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FORTIFIED_DISTRICTS_TOOLTIP]Fortified District[/TIP], adding 200 [icon:Action_Heal] HP, twice the wall defense strength of Medieval Walls when attacked, and no cost increase for further copies.
The triple land walls of Constantinople, unbreached for a thousand years.
Walls of Theodosius
Trojan Walls

Byzantine unique Antiquity Age [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WALL_TOOLTIP]Wall[/TIP], available from the Origins civic instead of Masonry. Turns the District into a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FORTIFIED_DISTRICTS_TOOLTIP]Fortified District[/TIP], adding 130 [icon:Action_Heal] HP and giving it a defense strength when attacked. Cheap to start, but each further copy in a Settlement costs 30% more.
Walls in the manner of Troy, the fortress of the Hellespont that held out for ten years.
